title: CPCBuild project
description: cpcbuild.json: marks a CPCBuild Studio project and lists its build targets.

library.description: Path to the cpcbuild checkout (folder with lib/ and tools/), relative to this file. null = use the cpcbuild.library.path setting or search upwards.

assets.description: Glob patterns of Studio asset documents.

id.description: Unique target id; also the output file name in build/.

main.description: The .bas file to compile, relative to this file.

defines.description: -D NAME or NAME=VALUE. The arch macro __CPC__ is automatic.

ownFont.description: Adds -D CPC_OWNFONT (a cartridge has no firmware font).

org.description: Origin (--org): 0x8000, &8000 or decimal. On the CPC at least &0040.

heap.description: Heap size in bytes (zxbc -H); used by the Spectrum targets.

package.description: dsk: AMSDOS disc (mkdsk.py). cpr: Plus cartridge (needs bare and ownFont). bin: raw output. tap: Spectrum tape (arch zx48k).

disc.description: AMSDOS name of the program on the disc: 1-8 characters A-Z 0-9 (run"NAME). Derived from the target id when absent.
